title: DATA↔BACK-HEALTH-002: Pipeline Health + Query Performance Feedback
description: Data reports ingest→storage pipeline health and query performance back to Backend; covers Segment B (DATA-owned) and the joint End-to-End telemetry-integrity SLO. Grounded in DATA_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.1 (Joint Telemetry-Integrity SLO). Companion to DATA↔BACK-INGEST-001.

segment_b_slo.description: DATA-owned SLO: ingest routing point → time-series DB / data lake.

commit_target_pct.description: ≥ 99.9% of routing-point messages committed to storage.

end_to_end_slo.description: Joint SLO: device telemetry → storage, reconciled via device-side sequence numbers vs. storage record counts.

target_pct.description: ≥ 99.8% of device-emitted messages committed to storage.

sequence_reconciliation_gap.description: Count of device sequence numbers with no matching storage record.

write_throughput_per_s.description: Sustained time-series write throughput (target SCALE-5: 50,000 writes/s).

slo_breach.description: Breach record; any breach triggers a joint RCA within 2 business days.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine health/performance reporting. A sustained SLO breach is an erosion-shaped signal (see §8.5) and may escalate to Tier-2 if architectural (e.g., DB scaling) remediation is needed.
x-macp.cadence: CONTINUOUS (SLO computed continuously, reviewed at monthly Backend-Data sync); SLA_FROM_EVENT (joint RCA within 2 business days of breach)
confirm_conditions: segment_b_slo.measured_pct ≥ 99.9 within 10 s and end_to_end_slo.measured_pct ≥ 99.8 within 15 s
if slo_breach.breached = true, rca_due_date is set
reject_conditions: breach reported with breached = true but no rca_due_date
sequence_reconciliation_gap > 0 declared healthy (silent loss — never accept)
end-to-end measured_pct below 99.8 presented as meeting target
counter_conditions: query_p95_latency_ms trending toward a downstream API breach — request capacity review
measured_pct marginal and within noise — request a longer measurement window before sign-off
